title: QIK-VRT Evidence Claim Boundaries
principle: Evidence MUST NOT be transferred across claim layers, repository heads, subjects, or runtime effects without an explicit bound proof for the target claim.

does_not_establish: kernel-checked theorem validity unless separately proved

establishes: only the exact theorem statements accepted by the specified proof kernel for the bound source and dependencies
required_evidence: successful kernel check bound to the exact source

establishes: only the validated protocol transition and bindings explicitly checked by the implementation
required_evidence: actual SHA-256 computation over bound bytes
negative_controls: list length alone is insufficient for clause completeness
duplicate clause identifiers MUST be rejected where uniqueness is required
does_not_establish: truth of referenced evidence merely from its digest

establishes: only the effect directly observed and independently read back for the exact runtime subject
required_evidence: bound prepare/commit or equivalent admitted transition
native payload/body digest binding where applicable
does_not_establish: effects on another host, head, PR, subject, or environment
merge, deployment, publication, or EFFECT_ACK_DONE unless each is directly evidenced

forbidden_inferences: evidence between different Git heads without explicit rebinding
evidence between different PRs without explicit rebinding

status_vocabulary.UNVERIFIED: No bound evidence for the claim.
status_vocabulary.VERIFIED_RUNTIME_EFFECT: Exact observed effect for the bound runtime subject only.
